dslRule:
<!id: stringbuffer.to.stringbuilder.local>
<!description: Replace StringBuffer with StringBuilder for local variables for better performance, as StringBuilder is not thread-safe and should not be used in shared contexts.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: performance, java5, thread-safety>

new java.lang.StringBuffer($args$) :: isAssignedToLocalVariable()
=> new java.lang.StringBuilder($args$)
;;
summary: Replaces StringBuffer constructor calls with StringBuilder for local variables.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
